task_objective: Require matching quotes around literals in the three loose secret rules, downgrade obvious placeholders without suppressing their findings, and re-evaluate the three plugins excluded by plugin-additions.

setup.remote_dev_pull: Attempted git pull --ff-only origin dev; origin has no dev ref, so the clean local dev tip 0c2b2d7 was used as the required base.
setup.plan_history: The plan was already committed as the dev tip, so feat/secret-rule-precision inherited the required plan-first commit instead of creating a duplicate empty commit.
setup.tooling: The repository has no run.sh. UV_CACHE_DIR was isolated under /tmp because the sandboxed global uv cache was read-only. Re-audits reused Trivy 0.73.0 and ClamAV 1.4.5 with packaged signature databases staged under /tmp; no host packages were installed.

implementation.quoted_literals: generic_api_key, bearer_token and cloudflare_token now require a quoted value with a matching closing quote. Their keyword alternations and minimum lengths remain unchanged, and quoted values are captured without exposing them on report surfaces.
implementation.placeholders: For those three rules only, a repeated-character value or a value containing example, placeholder, changeme, your-, xxx, <, >, {{, or TODO remains a finding but is classified PASS_WITH_WARNINGS.
implementation.fixture_handling: Existing test-fixture detection remains in place and continues to downgrade matching fixtures to PASS_WITH_WARNINGS.
implementation.redaction: redact_secrets now redacts the named value capture rather than the quote capture for the three corrected rules.

re_audits.disposition: Left out. verification_evidence.quality_gates: ruff check passed; 27 files already formatted; 224 passed and 21 subtests passed; no deleted review notes.
verification_evidence.plugin_re_audit: 3 reports: previous BLOCK=3; new BLOCK=1 and MANUAL_REVIEW=2; 2 plugins added back. Both required scanners passed for all three reports.
verification_evidence.audit_cache_invalidation: Confirmed compute_audit_context_hash hashes the resolved audit_plugins.py bytes, and cache keys include that context hash, so changing the rules naturally invalidates old cached verdicts without a manual purge.

test_adjustment_rationale: The initial cloudflare real-secret control assumed one finding, but cf_token also intentionally matches the unchanged broad bearer_token keyword alternation. The test was corrected before implementation to require the cloudflare finding and require every overlapping finding to remain BLOCK; no expected classification was weakened.
not_verified: The change does not measure secret-rule recall. An unquoted credential constant can now be missed, which is the plan's accepted tradeoff for removing BLOCK-severity false positives.
The bearer and token keyword alternations remain broad and unchanged.
Only the three named repositories were re-audited. Other cached reports will be invalidated naturally by the changed audit context hash.
